title: Compliance with Two Vaccination Regimens of Freeze-Dried Human Rabies Vaccine (Vero Cell) and Influencing Factors in Hubei Province, China
abstract: Objective: To systematically analyze the practical application and differences in vaccination compliance of two rabies post-exposure prophylaxis regimens based on real-world data, and to explore the associated influencing factors of vaccination compliance, aiming to provide evidence for optimizing vaccination strategies. Methods: Vaccination records of exposed individuals who received the freeze-dried human rabies vaccine (Vero cell) documented in the Hubei Provincial Immunization Information Management System from 1 January to 31 December 2024 were retrospectively collected to evaluate compliance with the five-dose (Essen) and four-dose (Zagreb) vaccination schedules. Good compliance was defined as completing the vaccination according to the schedule within the prescribed time frame. The evaluation included the vaccination compliance rate and the full-course vaccination rate. Factors associated with compliance were explored using univariate and multivariable analyses. Results: A total of 51,066 subjects were enrolled. The four-dose (Zagreb) schedule was associated with significantly higher vaccination compliance (77.1% vs. 72.0%, χ2 = 94.913, p < 0.05) and full-course completion rates (85.2% vs. 82.4%, χ2 = 38.251, p < 0.05), whereas the five-dose (Essen) regimen was associated with a higher rate of timely initial vaccination (81.7% vs. 78.1%, χ2 = 61.602, p < 0.05). In the multivariable analysis, the four-dose (Zagreb) regimen was also associated with increased full-course completion (aOR = 1.49, 95% CI = 1.39–1.60) and better compliance (aOR = 1.52, 95% CI = 1.43–1.61), whereas in a pre-specified, descriptive exploratory model, it was associated with delayed first doses (exploratory aOR = 0.84, 95% CI = 0.79–0.89); this adjusted association should not be interpreted as a causal effect of regimen on timely initiation. Younger age, lower-limb wounds, high-security occupations, farming, passive immunization and non-winter exposure were associated with better full-course vaccination; adults aged ≥18 years, males, Han/Miao ethnicity, Grade III exposure and cat bites were associated with lower compliance (p < 0.05). Severe exposure, farmer/student/resident identity, passive immunization and spring exposure were associated with more timely initiation, whereas male sex, neck-and-above exposure and flexible work were associated with less timely initiation (p < 0.05). Conclusions: In this retrospective, non-randomized study, receipt of the four-dose (Zagreb) regimen was associated with modestly higher full-course completion (absolute difference: 2.8 percentage points) and better compliance (5.1 percentage points) than the five-dose (Essen) regimen. Conversely, it was associated with a lower rate of timely first-dose vaccination. As an observational study, these findings do not establish causal relationships. Therefore, immediate wound care, prompt vaccination, and appropriate administration of rabies immunoglobulin remain the principal clinical priorities.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在基于真实数据,系统分析两种狂犬病 暴露后预防方案的实际应用情况及疫苗接种依从性差异,并探讨疫苗接种依从性的相关影响因素,旨在为优化疫苗接种策略提供依据。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究回顾性收集了湖北省免疫信息管理系统中2024年1月1日至12月31日期间接受冻干人狂犬病 疫苗(Vero细胞)的暴露者的疫苗接种记录,共纳入51,066名受试者。
elements_zh.methods: 使用单变量和多变量分析探讨与依从性相关的因素。良好的合规性定义为在规定的时间范围内按照时间表完成疫苗接种。
elements_zh.main_results: 四剂(萨格勒布)方案与显着较高的 疫苗接种 依从性(77.1% vs. 72.0%,χ2 = 94.913,p < 0.05)和全程完成率(85.2% vs. 82.4%,χ2 = 38.251,p < 0.05)相关,而五剂(埃森)方案则与显着较高的 疫苗接种 依从性相关。及时初始 疫苗接种 的比率较高(81.7% vs. 78.1%,χ2 = 61.602,p < 0.05)。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 与五剂(埃森)方案相比,四剂(萨格勒布)方案与较高的全程完成率(绝对差异:2.8 个百分点)和更好的依从性(5.1 个百分点)相关。然而,这也与及时首次接种 疫苗接种 的比率较低有关。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现表明,四剂量方案可能更有效地确保全程 疫苗接种 完成,这可以为在现实环境中改善 狂犬病 暴露后预防 的策略提供参考。立即伤口护理、及时 疫苗接种 和适当施用 狂犬病 免疫球蛋白仍然是主要的临床重点。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 作为一项观察性研究,这些发现并未建立因果关系。该研究是回顾性且非随机的,这可能会引入偏差并限制证据的强度。

analysis_en.methods: Factors associated with compliance were explored using univariate and multivariable analyses. Good compliance was defined as completing the vaccination according to the schedule within the prescribed time frame.
analysis_en.main_results: The four-dose (Zagreb) schedule was associated with significantly higher vaccination compliance (77.1% vs. 72.0%, χ2 = 94.913, p < 0.05) and full-course completion rates (85.2% vs. 82.4%, χ2 = 38.251, p < 0.05), whereas the five-dose (Essen) regimen was associated with a higher rate of timely initial vaccination (81.7% vs. 78.1%, χ2 = 61.602, p < 0.05).

title_zh: 中国湖北省冻干人 狂犬病 疫苗(Vero 细胞)两种 疫苗接种 治疗方案的符合性及影响因素
source_body_en: Objective: To systematically analyze the practical application and differences in vaccination compliance of two rabies post-exposure prophylaxis regimens based on real-world data, and to explore the associated influencing factors of vaccination compliance, aiming to provide evidence for optimizing vaccination strategies. Methods: Vaccination records of exposed individuals who received the freeze-dried human rabies vaccine (Vero cell) documented in the Hubei Provincial Immunization Information Management System from 1 January to 31 December 2024 were retrospectively collected to evaluate compliance with the five-dose (Essen) and four-dose (Zagreb) vaccination schedules. Good compliance was defined as completing the vaccination according to the schedule within the prescribed time frame. The evaluation included the vaccination compliance rate and the full-course vaccination rate. Factors associated with compliance were explored using univariate and multivariable analyses. Results: A total of 51,066 subjects were enrolled. The four-dose (Zagreb) schedule was associated with significantly higher vaccination compliance (77.1% vs. 72.0%, χ2 = 94.913, p < 0.05) and full-course completion rates (85.2% vs. 82.4%, χ2 = 38.251, p < 0.05), whereas the five-dose (Essen) regimen was associated with a higher rate of timely initial vaccination (81.7% vs. 78.1%, χ2 = 61.602, p < 0.05). In the multivariable analysis, the four-dose (Zagreb) regimen was also associated with increased full-course completion (aOR = 1.49, 95% CI = 1.39–1.60) and better compliance (aOR = 1.52, 95% CI = 1.43–1.61), whereas in a pre-specified, descriptive exploratory model, it was associated with delayed first doses (exploratory aOR = 0.84, 95% CI = 0.79–0.89); this adjusted association should not be interpreted as a causal effect of regimen on timely initiation. Younger age, lower-limb wounds, high-security occupations, farming, passive immunization and non-winter exposure were associated with better full-course vaccination; adults aged ≥18 years, males, Han/Miao ethnicity, Grade III exposure and cat bites were associated with lower compliance (p < 0.05). Severe exposure, farmer/student/resident identity, passive immunization and spring exposure were associated with more timely initiation, whereas male sex, neck-and-above exposure and flexible work were associated with less timely initiation (p < 0.05). Conclusions: In this retrospective, non-randomized study, receipt of the four-dose (Zagreb) regimen was associated with modestly higher full-course completion (absolute difference: 2.8 percentage points) and better compliance (5.1 percentage points) than the five-dose (Essen) regimen. Conversely, it was associated with a lower rate of timely first-dose vaccination. As an observational study, these findings do not establish causal relationships. Therefore, immediate wound care, prompt vaccination, and appropriate administration of rabies immunoglobulin remain the principal clinical priorities.

analysis_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在基于真实数据,系统分析两种狂犬病 暴露后预防方案的实际应用情况及疫苗接种依从性差异,并探讨疫苗接种依从性的相关影响因素,旨在为优化疫苗接种策略提供依据。
analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究回顾性收集了湖北省免疫信息管理系统中2024年1月1日至12月31日期间接受冻干人狂犬病 疫苗(Vero细胞)的暴露者的疫苗接种记录,共纳入51,066名受试者。
analysis_zh.methods: 使用单变量和多变量分析探讨与依从性相关的因素。良好的合规性定义为在规定的时间范围内按照时间表完成疫苗接种。
analysis_zh.main_results: 四剂(萨格勒布)方案与显着较高的 疫苗接种 依从性(77.1% vs. 72.0%,χ2 = 94.913,p < 0.05)和全程完成率(85.2% vs. 82.4%,χ2 = 38.251,p < 0.05)相关,而五剂(埃森)方案则与显着较高的 疫苗接种 依从性相关。及时初始 疫苗接种 的比率较高(81.7% vs. 78.1%,χ2 = 61.602,p < 0.05)。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 与五剂(埃森)方案相比,四剂(萨格勒布)方案与较高的全程完成率(绝对差异:2.8 个百分点)和更好的依从性(5.1 个百分点)相关。然而,这也与及时首次接种 疫苗接种 的比率较低有关。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现表明,四剂量方案可能更有效地确保全程 疫苗接种 完成,这可以为在现实环境中改善 狂犬病 暴露后预防 的策略提供参考。立即伤口护理、及时 疫苗接种 和适当施用 狂犬病 免疫球蛋白仍然是主要的临床重点。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 作为一项观察性研究,这些发现并未建立因果关系。该研究是回顾性且非随机的,这可能会引入偏差并限制证据的强度。

title: Knowledge, attitudes and practices among human rabies surveillance professionals: cross-sectional study, Nghe An province, Viet Nam, 2025
abstract: Objective: To evaluate knowledge, attitudes and practices (KAP) of health professionals regarding rabies surveillance in Nghe An province, Viet Nam, and identify associated factors. Methods: A cross-sectional, descriptive and analytical study was conducted from 6 May to 30 June 2025. A structured questionnaire was distributed online to staff of preventive medicine, clinical and vaccination service units involved in rabies surveillance in Nghe An. For association analyses, KAP scores were categorized as adequate (>=70%) or inadequate (<70%). Descriptive statistics and logistic regression were performed. Results: Overall, 29.2% (69/236) of respondents had inadequate knowledge scores, 5.1% (12/236) had inadequate attitude scores and 35.2% (83/236) had inadequate practice scores. Among preventive medicine staff, major gaps included 80.6% (79/98) reporting that they did not share bite-victim data with veterinary services and 60.2% (59/98) reporting that they did not use data-analysis tools. Altogether, 77.3% (85/110) of district-level staff and 78.5% (51/65) of private-facility staff were rated as having adequate knowledge compared with 50% (28/56) of commune-level staff. Having received training in the past 12 months was strongly associated with adequate practices (OR: 5.09, 95% CI: 2.86–9.05). In the adjusted model, adequate practices were associated with training in the past 12 months (aOR: 3.27, 95% CI: 1.46–7.34), district/provincial-level work (aOR: 3.16, 95% CI: 1.26–7.90), working at a private facility (aOR: 7.86, 95% CI: 1.98– 31.24) and bachelor’s level or higher education (aOR: 2.29, 95% CI: 1.02–5.14). Discussion: Substantial gaps in surveillance-specific knowledge and practices were observed among surveillance professionals in Nghe An, particularly in preventive medicine and commune-level settings. Targeted training, routine use of data-analysis tools and stronger intersectoral data-sharing in line with existing national regulations are urgently needed to support Viet Nam’s goal of eliminating dog-mediated human rabies deaths by 2030.

title_zh: 人类 狂犬病 监测 专业人员的知识、态度和实践:横断面研究,越南义安省,2025 年
source_body_en: Objective: To evaluate knowledge, attitudes and practices (KAP) of health professionals regarding rabies surveillance in Nghe An province, Viet Nam, and identify associated factors. Methods: A cross-sectional, descriptive and analytical study was conducted from 6 May to 30 June 2025. A structured questionnaire was distributed online to staff of preventive medicine, clinical and vaccination service units involved in rabies surveillance in Nghe An. For association analyses, KAP scores were categorized as adequate (>=70%) or inadequate (<70%). Descriptive statistics and logistic regression were performed. Results: Overall, 29.2% (69/236) of respondents had inadequate knowledge scores, 5.1% (12/236) had inadequate attitude scores and 35.2% (83/236) had inadequate practice scores. Among preventive medicine staff, major gaps included 80.6% (79/98) reporting that they did not share bite-victim data with veterinary services and 60.2% (59/98) reporting that they did not use data-analysis tools. Altogether, 77.3% (85/110) of district-level staff and 78.5% (51/65) of private-facility staff were rated as having adequate knowledge compared with 50% (28/56) of commune-level staff. Having received training in the past 12 months was strongly associated with adequate practices (OR: 5.09, 95% CI: 2.86–9.05). In the adjusted model, adequate practices were associated with training in the past 12 months (aOR: 3.27, 95% CI: 1.46–7.34), district/provincial-level work (aOR: 3.16, 95% CI: 1.26–7.90), working at a private facility (aOR: 7.86, 95% CI: 1.98– 31.24) and bachelor’s level or higher education (aOR: 2.29, 95% CI: 1.02–5.14). Discussion: Substantial gaps in surveillance-specific knowledge and practices were observed among surveillance professionals in Nghe An, particularly in preventive medicine and commune-level settings. Targeted training, routine use of data-analysis tools and stronger intersectoral data-sharing in line with existing national regulations are urgently needed to support Viet Nam’s goal of eliminating dog-mediated human rabies deaths by 2030.

title: SYN023, a Humanized Monoclonal Antibody Cocktail, Broadly Neutralizes Genetically Diverse Lyssaviruses and Validates Epitope Prediction Accuracy
abstract: Background/Objectives: Lyssaviruses pose a persistent global public health threat, underscoring the need for broad-spectrum neutralizing antibodies to improve rabies post-exposure prophylaxis (PEP). The humanized monoclonal antibody cocktail SYN023 is approved for PEP in China and under active global regulatory review. This study aimed to validate pseudovirus-based neutralization assays, verify SYN023 epitope prediction accuracy, and systematically characterize its pan-lyssavirus neutralizing activity. Methods: Assay validation was performed by directly comparing neutralization titers obtained with authentic rabies virus (RABV) and pseudotyped virus. Epitope analysis was performed, followed by in vivo evaluation in a canine PEP challenge model. The pseudovirus-based neutralization assay was used to assess SYN023 broad-spectrum activity across diverse lyssaviruses. Results: Neutralization titers from authentic and pseudotyped viruses showed high concordance (R2 = 0.8341, p < 0.0001), supporting the pseudovirus system as a reliable surrogate assay. Epitope analysis confirmed that SYN023’s epitope is fully conserved in the highly virulent New York City (NYC) RABV strain. In canine PEP challenge studies using the NYC strain, SYN023 conferred strong protection at 0.1–0.5 mg/kg. SYN023 exhibited potent neutralizing activity against phylogenetically diverse non-rabies lyssaviruses, including Mokola virus (MOKV; EC50 = 14.74 μg/mL), whereas three clinically validated reference antibodies failed to neutralize MOKV even at concentrations up to 1000 μg/mL. Conclusions: This study demonstrates that the pseudovirus-based neutralization assay is a reliable surrogate assay. It also confirms the functional accuracy of the epitope mapping strategy and demonstrates the broad neutralization spectrum of SYN023 against a diverse panel of lyssaviruses.

This study aimed to validate pseudovirus-based neutralization assays, verify SYN023 epitope prediction accuracy, and systematically characterize its pan-lyssavirus neutralizing activity. Methods: Assay validation was performed by directly comparing neutralization titers obtained with authentic rabies virus (RABV) and pseudotyped virus. Epitope analysis was performed, followed by in vivo evaluation in a canine PEP challenge model. The pseudovirus-based neutralization assay was used to assess SYN023 broad-spectrum activity across diverse lyssaviruses. Results: Neutralization titers from authentic and pseudotyped viruses showed high concordance (R2 = 0.8341, p < 0.0001), supporting the pseudovirus system as a reliable surrogate assay. Epitope analysis confirmed that SYN023’s epitope is fully conserved in the highly virulent New York City (NYC) RABV strain. In canine PEP challenge studies using the NYC strain, SYN023 conferred strong protection at 0.1–0.5 mg/kg. SYN023 exhibited potent neutralizing activity against phylogenetically diverse non-rabies lyssaviruses, including Mokola virus (MOKV; EC50 = 14.74 μg/mL), whereas three clinically validated reference antibodies failed to neutralize MOKV even at concentrations up to 1000 μg/mL. Conclusions: This study demonstrates that the pseudovirus-based neutralization assay is a reliable surrogate assay. It also confirms the functional accuracy of the epitope mapping strategy and demonstrates the broad neutralization spectrum of SYN023 against a diverse panel of lyssaviruses.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 该研究旨在验证基于假病毒的广谱中和抗体中和测定,并系统地表征 SYN023(一种人源化单克隆抗体混合物)的泛狂犬病病毒中和活​​性,以改善 狂犬病 暴露后预防 (PEP)。狂犬病病毒对全球公共卫生构成持续威胁,凸显了对广谱中和抗体的需求。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究在犬 PEP 攻击模型中评估了人源化单克隆抗体混合物 SYN023,并使用基于假病毒的中和测定来评估其针对多种狂犬病病毒的活性。
elements_zh.methods: 通过比较用真实的 狂犬病病毒 (RABV) 和假型病毒获得的中和滴度进行测定验证。进行表位分析,并在犬 PEP 攻击模型中进行体内评估。基于假病毒的中和测定用于评估 SYN023 在不同狂犬病病毒中的广谱活性。
elements_zh.main_results: 真实病毒和假病毒的中和滴度表现出高度一致性(R2 = 0.8341,p < 0.0001)。表位分析证实了表位作图策略的功能准确性。SYN023 对系统发育多样化的非 狂犬病 狂犬病病毒表现出有效的中和活性,包括 Mokola 病毒(MOKV;EC50 = 14.74 μg/mL),而三种经过临床验证的参考抗体即使在浓度高达 1000 μg/mL 时也无法中和 MOKV。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 该研究表明,基于假病毒的中和测定是一种可靠的替代测定,并证实了表位作图策略的功能准确性。它还展示了 SYN023 对多种狂犬病病毒(包括 MOKV)的广泛中和谱。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现可以为改进的 狂犬病 PEP 的开发提供信息,并突显 SYN023 针对狂犬病毒的广谱保护的潜力。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究的设计局限性包括使用犬类模型和缺乏人类数据。由于使用了替代测定并且需要进一步的人体验证,证据强度中等。

abstract_zh: 背景/目标:狂犬病病毒对全球公共卫生构成持续威胁,强调需要广谱中和抗体来改善 狂犬病 暴露后预防 (PEP)。人源化单克隆抗体鸡尾酒SYN023在中国获批用于PEP,并正在接受全球监管机构的积极审查。本研究旨在验证基于假病毒的中和测定,验证 SYN023 表位预测的准确性,并系统地表征其泛狂犬病病毒中和活​​性。方法:通过直接比较真实 狂犬病病毒 (RABV) 和假型病毒获得的中和滴度来进行测定验证。进行表位分析,然后在犬 PEP 攻击模型中进行体内评估。基于假病毒的中和测定用于评估 SYN023 在不同狂犬病毒中的广谱活性。结果:真实病毒和假病毒的中和滴度表现出高度一致性(R2 = 0.8341,p < 0.0001),支持假病毒系统作为可靠的替代检测。表位分析证实,SYN023 的表位在高毒力的纽约市 (NYC) RABV 毒株中完全保守。在使用 NYC 菌株的犬 PEP 攻击研究中,SYN023 在 0.1-0.5 mg/kg 剂量下提供了强大的保护。SYN023 对系统发育多样化的非 狂犬病 狂犬病病毒表现出有效的中和活性,包括 Mokola 病毒(MOKV;EC50 = 14.74 μg/mL),而三种经过临床验证的参考抗体即使在浓度高达 1000 μg/mL 时也无法中和 MOKV。结论:本研究表明基于假病毒的中和测定是一种可靠的替代测定。它还证实了表位作图策略的功能准确性,并证明了 SYN023 针对多种狂犬病病毒组的广泛中和谱。

title: Thực trạng kiến thức, thực hành về phòng chống bệnh dại và một số yếu tố liên quan ở người của người dân đến tiêm phòng tại trung tâm kiểm soát bệnh tật tỉnh Vĩnh Phúc năm 2024 Knowledge and practice on human rabies prevention and associated factors among individuals seeking post-exposure prophylaxis at vinh phuc center for disease control in 2024
abstract: Nghiên cứu nhằm mục tiêu mô tả thực trạng kiến thức, thực hành về phòng chống bệnh dại ở người vàmột số yếu tố liên quan của người dân đến tiêm phòng tại Trung tâm Kiểm soát bệnh tật (CDC) tỉnh VĩnhPhúc năm 2024. Thiết kế nghiên cứu mô tả cắt ngang được thực hiện trên 169 người dân đến tiêm phòngdại do động vật cắn/cào từ tháng 3 đến tháng 11 năm 2024. Kết quả nghiên cứu cho thấy: Tỷ lệ đối tượngcó kiến thức đạt về phòng chống bệnh dại chiếm 56,2%; trong đó kiến thức về phòng bệnh bằng vắc xinđạt cao nhất (100%), nhưng kiến thức về xử trí vết thương đúng cách và phác đồ tiêm vắc xin còn hạn chế.Tỷ lệ đối tượng có thực hành đạt về phòng chống bệnh dại là 63,9%. Đối tượng nghiên cứu tới ngay cơ sởy tế sau khi xử trí vết thương ban đầu chiếm 92,3%. Phân tích mối liên quan cho thấy các yếu tố: trình độhọc vấn và hoàn cảnh kinh tế với thực hành phòng chống bệnh dại của đối tượng nghiên cứu (p < 0,05).Kiến thức và thực hành về phòng chống bệnh dại của người dân đến tiêm phòng tại Trung tâm Kiểm soátbệnh tật tỉnh Vĩnh Phúc còn chưa đồng đều, đặc biệt đối với các nội dung liên quan đến xử trí ban đầusau phơi nhiễm và nhận biết bệnh dại. Do đó, cần tăng cường truyền thông giáo dục sức khỏe, chú trọnghướng dẫn xử trí đúng sau phơi nhiễm và nâng cao nhận thức của người dân nhằm góp phần giảm nguycơ mắc và tử vong do bệnh dại.

title: Nationwide registry-based analysis of rabies exposures in Iran: Epidemiological patterns and post-exposure prophylaxis adherence
abstract: BACKGROUND: Animal bites remain an important public health issue in Iran. Understanding their epidemiological patterns and examining how registry-recorded cases are managed in relation to the Iranian rabies protocol and World Health Organization recommendations can provide insight into clinical practice and documentation quality within the national bite registry. Such analyses help identify strengths and gaps in protocol adherence and data completeness. METHODOLOGY/PRINCIPAL FINDINGS: We conducted a secondary analysis of 507,404 animal bite cases recorded in the national rabies registry between March 2022 and September 2023. The unit of analysis was registry-recorded exposure visits. Data on demographics, exposure characteristics, and clinical management were examined to describe epidemiological patterns and assess documented adherence to recommended post-exposure prophylaxis (PEP) practices. Males accounted for 73.6% of cases. The largest age group among all patients was 31-40 years, comprising 19.8% of cases. Dogs were responsible for 76.2% of exposures and cats for 20.8%. Northern provinces such as North Khorasan (773 per 100,000) and Golestan (767 per 100,000) recorded the highest incidence. Wound irrigation was documented in 94.3% of patients, and 96.4% received the first vaccine dose within 48 hours. Overall, 68.1% received three vaccine doses and 24.2% four doses. Rabies immunoglobulin was administered to 95.6% of Category III exposures, though inappropriate use was also observed in Category I (6.1%) and II (4.7%). Deviations from vaccine regimens and misclassification of exposure categories were identified, and among bat-related exposures only 36.8% were classified as Category III, with 38.7% receiving immunoglobulin. CONCLUSIONS/SIGNIFICANCE: Among registry-recorded animal bite attendees, rapid initiation of PEP and frequent appropriate use of rabies immunoglobulin in severe exposures were documented. However, gaps in documentation, vaccine dosing accuracy, and exposure classification indicate areas for improvement. These findings reflect patterns within the national bite registry and should not be interpreted as a comprehensive evaluation of all surveillance system attributes. Strengthening provider training, reinforcing protocol adherence, and improving data quality within the registry could support national rabies control efforts and inform broader prevention strategies aligned with global elimination goals.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 该研究旨在了解伊朗动物咬伤的流行病学模式,并评估对 暴露后预防 (PEP) 做法的遵守情况,从而解决公共卫生问题。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 对 2022 年 3 月至 2023 年 9 月期间记录的 507,404 起动物咬伤案件进行了全国范围内的登记分析。
elements_zh.methods: 该研究涉及对登记处记录的暴露访问进行二次分析,检查人口统计、暴露特征和临床管理。
elements_zh.main_results: 男性占病例的73.6%,最大年龄组为31-40岁(19.8%)。狗占 76.2%,猫占 20.8%。北方省份的 发病率 最高。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 研究结果显示,在严重暴露情况下,可以快速启动 PEP 并经常适当使用 狂犬病 免疫球蛋白,但在文件记录、疫苗 剂量准确性和暴露分类方面发现了差距。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现反映了国家咬伤登记中的模式,可以为提供者培训、协议遵守和数据质量改进提供信息,以支持国家 狂犬病 控制工作。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究受到文件、疫苗 剂量准确性和暴露分类方面的空白的限制,表明了需要改进的领域。研究结果不应被解释为对所有 监测 系统属性的综合评估。

title: Participatory Communication and Mass Dog Vaccination for Effective Rabies Management in Mitooma District, Western Uganda: An Exploratory Study
abstract: ABSTRACT Background Canine rabies remains an endemic public health threat in Mitooma District, Uganda, where traditional, top–down public health interventions frequently fail to achieve the required 70% mass dog vaccination (MDV) coverage due to limited community engagement and one‐way communication. Objectives This exploratory study evaluated the effectiveness of participatory communication in enhancing community engagement in MDV programs at the human–dog–wildlife interface in Mitooma District and identified the sociocultural and ecological factors influencing rabies control. Methods Four gender‐segregated focus group discussions were conducted across four purposively selected parishes (Kiyanga, Kaburara, Iraramira, and Kashasha) in Kiyanga sub‐county, Mitooma District. Data were analyzed using thematic framework analysis. Results Critical gaps persist regarding paralytic rabies, non‐bite transmission pathways, and wildlife reservoirs, whereas inadequate interactive education drives the adoption of harmful traditional wound care. Furthermore, top–down vaccination mismatches and utilitarian canine views trigger booster noncompliance and ownership denial to evade medical and legal liabilities. Conclusion Rabies persistence in Mitooma District is fundamentally driven by a failure of bidirectional community engagement and multi‐sectoral coordination. Shifting from top–down public health messaging to a One Health participatory communication framework is necessary to establish sustainable community co‐ownership and break the transmission cycle.

abstract_zh: 摘要背景 犬类 狂犬病 仍然是乌干达米图马区的一种地方性公共卫生威胁,由于社区参与和单向沟通有限,传统的自上而下的公共卫生干预措施经常无法实现所需的 70% 的犬类 狂犬病 (MDV) 覆盖率。目标 这项探索性研究评估了参与式沟通在增强 Mitooma 地区人-狗-野生动物交界处的 MDV 项目社区参与方面的有效性,并确定了影响 狂犬病 控制的社会文化和生态因素。方法 在米图马区基扬加县的四个有目的地选择的教区(基扬加、卡布拉拉、伊拉拉米拉和卡沙沙)进行了四次按性别隔离的焦点小组讨论。使用主题框架分析对数据进行分析。结果 在麻痹性 狂犬病、非咬合性 传播 通路和野生动物 储存宿主 方面仍然存在严重差距,而互动教育不足则导致采用有害的传统伤口护理。此外,自上而下的 疫苗接种 不匹配和功利主义的犬类观点会引发助推器不合规和否认所有权,以逃避医疗和法律责任。结论 Mitooma 地区 狂犬病 的持续存在从根本上来说是由于双向社区参与和多部门协调的失败造成的。从自上而下的公共卫生信息传递转向同一个健康参与式沟通框架对于建立可持续的社区共同所有权和打破 传播 循环是必要的。

title: Situation Analysis of Rabies Surveillance and Dog Bite Management in Manufahi Municipality of Timor-Leste, 2025: A Mixed-Methods Quality Data Audit
abstract: Objectives: Rabies has emerged as a significant public health threat in Timor-Leste, with 24 recorded human deaths since the disease first appeared in early 2024. While initially concentrated in border areas, the virus has spread to multiple municipalities, including Manufahi Municipality. This study presents a situational analysis of dog bite management concerning rabies risk, the timeliness of surveillance reports, and operational factors in Manufahi Municipality during 2025. Methods: A mixed-methods quality data audit was employed across four community health centers. Data collection encompassed direct observations of clinical areas, semi-structured interviews with 17 essential health personnel, and a methodical review and cross-verification of outpatient and laboratory register books. Results: The surveillance system achieved 100% timeliness in weekly reporting. In 2025, Manufahi Municipality recorded 295 dog bite cases, corresponding to an incidence of 4.63 per 1,000 population. Two patients (0.7%) died with clinical signs consistent with rabies. Children aged 5 to 14 years had the highest burden, accounting for 52.9% of cases. While vaccines arrived in June 2025, first-dose anti-rabies vaccine (ARV) coverage reached 84.4% overall (249/295) and 87.7% among eligible category II and III exposures (249/284). However, multi-dose adherence dropped to 28.9% (2 doses; 82/284) and 7.0% (3 doses; 20/284). Rabies immune globulin (RIG) coverage was 13.7% (31/226) among high-risk category III cases. Public Health Recommendations: Improving rabies control requires standardizing reporting formats and prioritizing the digitalization of surveillance systems. Adopting a "One Health" approach and enhancing community-level vaccine accessibility are vital for sustainable disease elimination.

title_zh: 2025 年东帝汶马努法希市 狂犬病 监测 和狗咬伤管理情况分析:混合方法质量数据审计
source_body_en: Objectives: Rabies has emerged as a significant public health threat in Timor-Leste, with 24 recorded human deaths since the disease first appeared in early 2024. While initially concentrated in border areas, the virus has spread to multiple municipalities, including Manufahi Municipality. This study presents a situational analysis of dog bite management concerning rabies risk, the timeliness of surveillance reports, and operational factors in Manufahi Municipality during 2025. Methods: A mixed-methods quality data audit was employed across four community health centers. Data collection encompassed direct observations of clinical areas, semi-structured interviews with 17 essential health personnel, and a methodical review and cross-verification of outpatient and laboratory register books. Results: The surveillance system achieved 100% timeliness in weekly reporting. In 2025, Manufahi Municipality recorded 295 dog bite cases, corresponding to an incidence of 4.63 per 1,000 population. Two patients (0.7%) died with clinical signs consistent with rabies. Children aged 5 to 14 years had the highest burden, accounting for 52.9% of cases. While vaccines arrived in June 2025, first-dose anti-rabies vaccine (ARV) coverage reached 84.4% overall (249/295) and 87.7% among eligible category II and III exposures (249/284). However, multi-dose adherence dropped to 28.9% (2 doses; 82/284) and 7.0% (3 doses; 20/284). Rabies immune globulin (RIG) coverage was 13.7% (31/226) among high-risk category III cases. Public Health Recommendations: Improving rabies control requires standardizing reporting formats and prioritizing the digitalization of surveillance systems. Adopting a "One Health" approach and enhancing community-level vaccine accessibility are vital for sustainable disease elimination.

title: From Retina to Brain: Viral Tools for Targeting Retinal Cells and Mapping Visual Circuits.
abstract: The retina serves as a uniquely accessible entry point to the central nervous system, enabling both cell type-specific manipulation and circuit-level interrogation of visual pathways. Viral vectors have emerged as indispensable tools in this context, facilitating precise gene delivery, functional perturbation, and connectivity mapping across retinal and brain circuits. Among retinal neurons, retinal ganglion cells (RGCs) represent a major focus due to their role as the sole output neurons conveying visual information to central targets. Accordingly, recent advances in viral engineering including capsid design, transcriptional targeting, and synthetic regulatory elements have significantly improved the efficiency and specificity of RGC-directed gene delivery, while also enabling targeting of diverse retinal cell populations. Beyond retinal targeting, viral tools have transformed the study of RGC connectivity with downstream brain nuclei. In particular, transsynaptic and projection-specific viral strategies now enable mapping of RGC inputs and outputs across visual pathways with increasing precision. Approaches using retrograde AAVs, monosynaptic rabies systems, and anterograde tracers have revealed complex, cell type-dependent wiring patterns linking the retina to thalamic, midbrain, and cortical circuits. In this review, we highlight current viral technologies for targeting RGCs and other retinal cell types and subsequently discuss viral approaches for dissecting retinal-brain connectivity. Together, these complementary strategies provide a powerful framework for linking molecular identity, circuit architecture, and visual function, thereby advancing both basic neuroscience and translational efforts in vision research.

analysis.summary_en: This review concerns viral tools for targeting retinal cells and mapping visual circuits. The target-specific evidence is limited to monosynaptic rabies systems, which are mentioned among retrograde AAVs and anterograde tracers used to reveal complex, cell type-dependent wiring patterns linking the retina to thalamic, midbrain, and cortical circuits. title_zh: 从视网膜到大脑:针对视网膜细胞和绘制视觉回路的病毒工具。
source_body_en: The retina serves as a uniquely accessible entry point to the central nervous system, enabling both cell type-specific manipulation and circuit-level interrogation of visual pathways. Viral vectors have emerged as indispensable tools in this context, facilitating precise gene delivery, functional perturbation, and connectivity mapping across retinal and brain circuits. Among retinal neurons, retinal ganglion cells (RGCs) represent a major focus due to their role as the sole output neurons conveying visual information to central targets. Accordingly, recent advances in viral engineering including capsid design, transcriptional targeting, and synthetic regulatory elements have significantly improved the efficiency and specificity of RGC-directed gene delivery, while also enabling targeting of diverse retinal cell populations. Beyond retinal targeting, viral tools have transformed the study of RGC connectivity with downstream brain nuclei. In particular, transsynaptic and projection-specific viral strategies now enable mapping of RGC inputs and outputs across visual pathways with increasing precision. Approaches using retrograde AAVs, monosynaptic rabies systems, and anterograde tracers have revealed complex, cell type-dependent wiring patterns linking the retina to thalamic, midbrain, and cortical circuits. In this review, we highlight current viral technologies for targeting RGCs and other retinal cell types and subsequently discuss viral approaches for dissecting retinal-brain connectivity. Together, these complementary strategies provide a powerful framework for linking molecular identity, circuit architecture, and visual function, thereby advancing both basic neuroscience and translational efforts in vision research.
abstract_zh: 视网膜是中枢神经系统的独特入口点,可实现细胞类型特异性操作和视觉通路的电路级询问。病毒 媒介 已成为这种背景下不可或缺的工具,促进精确的基因传递、功能扰动以及视网膜和大脑回路的连接映射。在视网膜神经元中,视网膜神经节细胞(RGC)因其作为向中央目标传递视觉信息的唯一输出神经元的作用而成为主要焦点。因此,病毒工程的最新进展,包括衣壳设计、转录靶向和合成调控元件,显着提高了 RGC 引导的基因递送的效率和特异性,同时还能够靶向不同的视网膜细胞群。除了视网膜靶向之外,病毒工具还改变了 RGC 与下游脑核连接的研究。特别是,跨突触和投射特异性病毒策略现在能够以越来越高的精度映射视觉通路上的 RGC 输入和输出。使用逆行 AAV、单突触 狂犬病 系统和顺行示踪剂的方法揭示了连接视网膜与丘脑、中脑和皮质回路的复杂的、依赖于细胞类型的接线模式。在这篇综述中,我们重点介绍了当前针对 RGC 和其他视网膜细胞类型的病毒技术,并随后讨论了解剖视网膜-大脑连接的病毒方法。这些互补策略共同提供了一个强大的框架,用于连接分子身份、电路结构和视觉功能,从而推进基础神经科学和视觉研究的转化工作。

title: Combined Disruption of Multiple Cytokine Signaling Pathways Enables One-Step Anterograde Tracing with Vesicular Stomatitis Virus.
abstract: Defining the direct postsynaptic targets of selected neuronal populations remains a challenge for neural circuit mapping. Vesicular stomatitis virus (VSV) spreads efficiently in the anterograde direction, but replication-competent VSV undergoes multistep spread and therefore cannot distinguish direct from indirect downstream targets. Here, we developed a glycoprotein-deleted VSV (VSVdG)-based strategy for one-step anterograde tracing using AAV-mediated trans-complementation with adaptations. In this system, VSVdG was engineered to encode Cre, allowing a Cre-dependent AAV to express VSV-G only after VSVdG infected the same cells, thereby limiting VSV-G expression to a short time window. To reduce VSV-M-mediated cytotoxicity, we introduced the M33A/M51R double-mutant VSV-Md variant. Using the basal ganglia circuit as a model, we found that efficient one-step VSVdG spread required disruption of cytokine-mediated antiviral responses triggered by AAV transduction and VSV infection. This was achieved by loss of type I interferon signaling in IFNAR1 knock-out mice, together with suppression of additional antiviral responses either through AAV-mediated expression of CVS-N2c rabies virus phosphoprotein or administration of cytokine-blocking antibody cocktail. These adaptations enabled VSVdG spread from the dorsal striatum to expected downstream targets in mice of both sexes. However, downstream labeled cells included both neurons and glia, revealing an important limitation for interpreting this approach as strictly neuron-to-neuron monosynaptic anterograde spread. Overall, rather than providing a ready-to-use tracing tool, this study presents a VSVdG strategy for one-step anterograde circuit tracing and defines viral toxicity, innate immunity, and cell-type specificity constraints that must be addressed to develop an efficient and specific monosynaptic anterograde viral tracer.
journal: The Journal of neuroscience : the official journal of the Society for Neuroscience

analysis.research_question_and_background: Defining the direct postsynaptic targets of selected neuronal populations remains a challenge for neural circuit mapping. This study aimed to develop a strategy for one-step anterograde tracing using a modified vesicular stomatitis virus (VSV) system.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study involved the development of a glycoprotein-deleted VSV (VSVdG)-based strategy for one-step anterograde tracing using AAV-mediated trans-complementation. The research was conducted in mice of both sexes, with the basal ganglia circuit serving as a model system.
analysis.methods: The methods included engineering VSVdG to encode Cre, allowing a Cre-dependent AAV to express VSV-G only after VSVdG infected the same cells. To reduce VSV-M-mediated cytotoxicity, the M33A/M51R double-mutant VSV-Md variant was introduced. The system was tested in mice with disrupted cytokine-mediated antiviral responses.
analysis.main_results: Using the basal ganglia circuit as a model, the study found that efficient one-step VSVdG spread required disruption of cytokine-mediated antiviral responses triggered by AAV transduction and VSV infection. The adaptations enabled VSVdG spread from the dorsal striatum to expected downstream targets in mice of both sexes.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpreted these findings as demonstrating that the VSVdG strategy can enable one-step anterograde tracing, but they also highlighted that downstream labeled cells included both neurons and glia, revealing an important limitation for interpreting this approach as strictly neuron-to-neuron monosynaptic anterograde spread.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings can inform the development of more efficient and specific monosynaptic anterograde viral tracers for neural circuit mapping, which has implications for understanding brain connectivity and function.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study revealed that downstream labeled cells included both neurons and glia, indicating a limitation in interpreting the approach as strictly neuron-to-neuron monosynaptic anterograde spread. The evidence is moderate, as the study focuses on a specific model system and does not generalize to broader contexts.

analysis_en.research_question_and_background: Defining the direct postsynaptic targets of selected neuronal populations remains a challenge for neural circuit mapping. This study aimed to develop a strategy for one-step anterograde tracing using a modified vesicular stomatitis virus (VSV) system.
analysis_en.study_design_and_population: The study involved the development of a glycoprotein-deleted VSV (VSVdG)-based strategy for one-step anterograde tracing using AAV-mediated trans-complementation. The research was conducted in mice of both sexes, with the basal ganglia circuit serving as a model system.
analysis_en.methods: The methods included engineering VSVdG to encode Cre, allowing a Cre-dependent AAV to express VSV-G only after VSVdG infected the same cells. To reduce VSV-M-mediated cytotoxicity, the M33A/M51R double-mutant VSV-Md variant was introduced. The system was tested in mice with disrupted cytokine-mediated antiviral responses.
analysis_en.main_results: Using the basal ganglia circuit as a model, the study found that efficient one-step VSVdG spread required disruption of cytokine-mediated antiviral responses triggered by AAV transduction and VSV infection. The adaptations enabled VSVdG spread from the dorsal striatum to expected downstream targets in mice of both sexes.
analysis_en.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpreted these findings as demonstrating that the VSVdG strategy can enable one-step anterograde tracing, but they also highlighted that downstream labeled cells included both neurons and glia, revealing an important limitation for interpreting this approach as strictly neuron-to-neuron monosynaptic anterograde spread.
analysis_en.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings can inform the development of more efficient and specific monosynaptic anterograde viral tracers for neural circuit mapping, which has implications for understanding brain connectivity and function.
analysis_en.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study revealed that downstream labeled cells included both neurons and glia, indicating a limitation in interpreting the approach as strictly neuron-to-neuron monosynaptic anterograde spread. The evidence is moderate, as the study focuses on a specific model system and does not generalize to broader contexts.

title_zh: 多种细胞因子信号通路的联合破坏使水疱性口炎病毒的一步顺行追踪成为可能。
source_body_en: Defining the direct postsynaptic targets of selected neuronal populations remains a challenge for neural circuit mapping. Vesicular stomatitis virus (VSV) spreads efficiently in the anterograde direction, but replication-competent VSV undergoes multistep spread and therefore cannot distinguish direct from indirect downstream targets. Here, we developed a glycoprotein-deleted VSV (VSVdG)-based strategy for one-step anterograde tracing using AAV-mediated trans-complementation with adaptations. In this system, VSVdG was engineered to encode Cre, allowing a Cre-dependent AAV to express VSV-G only after VSVdG infected the same cells, thereby limiting VSV-G expression to a short time window. To reduce VSV-M-mediated cytotoxicity, we introduced the M33A/M51R double-mutant VSV-Md variant. Using the basal ganglia circuit as a model, we found that efficient one-step VSVdG spread required disruption of cytokine-mediated antiviral responses triggered by AAV transduction and VSV infection. This was achieved by loss of type I interferon signaling in IFNAR1 knock-out mice, together with suppression of additional antiviral responses either through AAV-mediated expression of CVS-N2c rabies virus phosphoprotein or administration of cytokine-blocking antibody cocktail. These adaptations enabled VSVdG spread from the dorsal striatum to expected downstream targets in mice of both sexes. However, downstream labeled cells included both neurons and glia, revealing an important limitation for interpreting this approach as strictly neuron-to-neuron monosynaptic anterograde spread. Overall, rather than providing a ready-to-use tracing tool, this study presents a VSVdG strategy for one-step anterograde circuit tracing and defines viral toxicity, innate immunity, and cell-type specificity constraints that must be addressed to develop an efficient and specific monosynaptic anterograde viral tracer.
abstract_zh: 定义选定神经元群的直接突触后目标仍然是神经回路映射的一个挑战。水疱性口炎病毒 (VSV) 可沿顺行方向有效传播,但具有复制能力的 VSV 会经历多步传播,因此无法区分直接下游目标和间接目标。在这里,我们开发了一种基于糖蛋白删除的 VSV (VSVdG) 的策略,使用 AAV 介导的反式互补和适应进行一步顺行追踪。在该系统中,VSVdG被设计为编码Cre,使得Cre依赖性AAV仅在VSVdG感染相同细胞后才表达VSV-G,从而将VSV-G的表达限制在较短的时间窗口内。为了减少 VSV-M 介导的细胞毒性,我们引入了 M33A/M51R 双突变 VSV-Md 变体。使用基底神经节回路作为模型,我们发现有效的一步式 VSVdG 传播需要破坏由 AAV 转导和 VSV 感染触发的细胞因子介导的 抗病毒药物 反应。这是通过 IFNAR1 敲除小鼠中 I 型干扰素信号传导的丧失,以及通过 AAV 介导的 CVS-N2c 狂犬病病毒 磷蛋白表达或施用细胞因子阻断抗体混合物抑制额外的 抗病毒药物 反应来实现的。这些适应使 VSVdG 从两性小鼠的背侧纹状体传播到预期的下游目标。然而,下游标记细胞包括神经元和神经胶质细胞,揭示了将这种方法解释为严格的神经元到神经元单突触顺行传播的一个重要限制。总体而言,本研究不是提供一种即用型追踪工具,而是提出了一种用于一步顺行回路追踪的 VSVdG 策略,并定义了病毒毒性、先天免疫和细胞类型特异性限制,开发一种高效且特异性的单突触顺行病毒示踪剂必须解决这些限制。

title: Increasing dog bites in humans: Indoor and outdoor risk factors and spatiotemporal patterns in Chile.
abstract: Dog bites pose a serious global public health problem, leading to at least 14,000 annual deaths globally, primarily from rabies, and contributing to physical injuries, psychological trauma, transmission to other zoonotic diseases, and substantial economic costs. This study aimed to estimate the spatiotemporal distribution of dog bite incidents involving humans in Chile and to analyze the risk factors associated with bites in indoor and outdoor environments. We analyzed data from the Registry System of Biting Animals (SIRAM) in Chile between 2019 and 2024. To examine spatiotemporal patterns of dog bites and associated risk factors, we conducted time-series analyses, spatial autocorrelation, and generalized linear mixed-effects models with a negative binomial distribution. The cumulative rate of reported dog bites was 263 (95% CI: 262.5-264.3) per 100,000 inhabitants and increased from 216 (95% CI: 214-218) per 100,000 inhabitants in 2019 to 400 (95% CI: 398-403) per 100,000 inhabitants in 2024. Cases were widely distributed across all regions, with clusters of municipalities showing high rates. The risk of reported dog bites was twice as high in outdoor compared to indoor settings (adjusted incidence rate ratio [aIRR]=2.01; 95% CI 1.98-2.03), and disproportionately affected males (aIRR=1.47; 95% CI 1.45-1.49) and individuals aged 10-69 years, whereas indoor bites presented more uniform risk patterns across demographic groups. Time series revealed an increasing trend since 2022 and a seasonal pattern. Regression models showed the highest reported bite rate occurred during the spring months in both indoor (aIRR=1.14; 95% CI 1.12-1.17) and outdoor (aIRR=1.2; 95% CI 1.18-1.22) settings. Dog bite incidents are a growing public health concern in Chile, influenced by human, animal, and environmental factors. This increase may reflect both a true rise in dog bite occurrence and improvements in surveillance sensitivity. Addressing this multifactorial problem requires a comprehensive One Health approach, including reducing the number of unsupervised dogs outdoors, raising public awareness, and establishing a comprehensive registry of severe and non-severe cases to assess the burden of dog bites. These measures are critical for the effective prevention and control of dog bite incidents.

source_records.abstract: Dog bites pose a serious global public health problem, leading to at least 14,000 annual deaths globally, primarily from rabies, and contributing to physical injuries, psychological trauma, transmission to other zoonotic diseases, and substantial economic costs. This study aimed to estimate the spatiotemporal distribution of dog bite incidents involving humans in Chile and to analyze the risk factors associated with bites in indoor and outdoor environments. We analyzed data from the Registry System of Biting Animals (SIRAM) in Chile between 2019 and 2024. To examine spatiotemporal patterns of dog bites and associated risk factors, we conducted time-series analyses, spatial autocorrelation, and generalized linear mixed-effects models with a negative binomial distribution. The cumulative rate of reported dog bites was 263 (95% CI: 262.5-264.3) per 100,000 inhabitants and increased from 216 (95% CI: 214-218) per 100,000 inhabitants in 2019 to 400 (95% CI: 398-403) per 100,000 inhabitants in 2024. Cases were widely distributed across all regions, with clusters of municipalities showing high rates. The risk of reported dog bites was twice as high in outdoor compared to indoor settings (adjusted incidence rate ratio [aIRR]=2.01; 95% CI 1.98-2.03), and disproportionately affected males (aIRR=1.47; 95% CI 1.45-1.49) and individuals aged 10-69 years, whereas indoor bites presented more uniform risk patterns across demographic groups. Time series revealed an increasing trend since 2022 and a seasonal pattern. Regression models showed the highest reported bite rate occurred during the spring months in both indoor (aIRR=1.14; 95% CI 1.12-1.17) and outdoor (aIRR=1.2; 95% CI 1.18-1.22) settings. Dog bite incidents are a growing public health concern in Chile, influenced by human, animal, and environmental factors. This increase may reflect both a true rise in dog bite occurrence and improvements in surveillance sensitivity. Addressing this multifactorial problem requires a comprehensive One Health approach, including reducing the number of unsupervised dogs outdoors, raising public awareness, and establishing a comprehensive registry of severe and non-severe cases to assess the burden of dog bites. These measures are critical for the effective prevention and control of dog bite incidents.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 该研究旨在估计智利涉及人类的狗咬伤事件的时空分布,并分析与室内和室外环境中的咬伤相关的风险因素。狗咬伤构成了严重的全球公共卫生问题,导致全球每年至少 14,000 人死亡,主要是因狗咬伤而死亡,并导致身体伤害、心理创伤、其他人畜共患疾病以及巨大的经济损失。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究分析了 2019 年至 2024 年间智利咬伤动物登记系统 (SIRAM) 的数据。病例广泛分布在所有地区,其中一些城市的发病率很高。
elements_zh.methods: 为了检查狗咬伤的时空模式和相关风险因素,我们进行了时间序列分析、空间自相关和具有负二项分布的广义线性混合效应模型。回归模型显示,在室内(aIRR=1.14;95% CI 1.12-1.17)和室外(aIRR=1.2;95% CI 1.18-1.22)环境中,报告的咬伤率最高发生在春季。
elements_zh.main_results: The cumulative rate of reported dog bites was 263 (95% CI: 262.5-264.3) per 100,000 inhabitants and increased from 216 (95% CI: 214-218) per 100,000 inhabitants in 2019 to 400 (95% CI: 398-403) per 100,000 inhabitants in 2024. The risk of reported dog bites was twice as high in outdoor compared to indoor settings (adjusted incidence rate ratio [aIRR]=2.01; 95% CI 1.98-2.03), and disproportionately affected males (aIRR=1.47; 95% CI 1.45-1.49) and individuals aged 10-69 years, whereas indoor bites presented more uniform risk patterns across demographic groups. Time series revealed an increasing trend since 2022 and a seasonal pattern.
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 受人类、动物和环境因素的影响,狗咬伤事件已成为智利日益严重的公共卫生问题。这些措施对于有效预防和控制狗咬伤事件至关重要。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 解决这一多因素问题需要采取全面的“同一个健康”方法,包括减少户外无人看管的狗的数量、提高公众意识以及建立严重和非严重病例的综合登记册以评估狗咬伤的负担。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究没有报告任何具体的设计限制或偏见。然而,报告的狗咬伤事件的增加趋势可能反映了狗咬伤发生率的真正上升和 监测 敏感性的改善。

title: A G4-nanotweezer/DNA tetrahedron-confined dual-mode ECL/SERS biosensor for ultrasensitive rabies viral RNA detection via CRISPR-Cas12a-regulated hemin switching.
abstract: Reliable detection of low-abundance rabies viral RNA (RABV RNA) requires sensitive readouts that tolerate interfacial and matrix-associated signal variation. We developed a DNA tetrahedron-confined G4-nanotweezer biosensor combining electrochemiluminescence (ECL) and surface-enhanced Raman scattering (SERS). A Ti 3 C 2 /CsPbBr 3 @PDA@AuNPs nanocomposite (PAM) provided the dual-mode transducing interface, with hemin serving as both an ECL-modulating species and a SERS reporter. CsPbBr 3 served as the ECL emitter, PDA improved interfacial stability, AuNPs provided SERS hotspots and DNA anchoring sites, and Ti 3 C 2 acted as a conductive scaffold. Without target RNA, the bridging strand (ST) promoted a closed G4/hemin configuration, producing high SERS and low ECL signals. RABV RNA-triggered binding-induced isothermal amplification generated single-stranded DNA activators for CRISPR-Cas12a. Subsequent ST cleavage prevented nanotweezer closure and reduced interfacial hemin enrichment, producing an ECL-on/SERS-off response. Control experiments linked hemin-associated ECL modulation to the interfacial configuration without establishing a unique microscopic quenching pathway. The ratiometric signal R = I ECL /I SERS enabled quantification over 1 aM to 50 fM. Additional low-concentration calibration yielded an estimated detection limit of 0.0675 aM by blank-threshold inverse prediction, extrapolated below the lowest measured nonzero standard of 0.10 aM. At 10 fM, matched-channel comparisons gave ratiometric relative standard deviations of 2.49% for ten successive readings and 2.87% across six independently prepared electrodes. In tenfold-diluted human serum at 10 fM, the ratio showed an 8.20% absolute deviation from phosphate-buffered saline, indicating partial matrix-effect compensation. This shared-reporter architecture links programmable DNA switching to complementary optical readouts for sensitive ratiometric viral RNA analysis.

analysis.summary_en: This study presents a novel biosensor for ultrasensitive rabies viral RNA detection. The biosensor combines G4-nanotweezer and DNA tetrahedron technologies with electrochemiluminescence (ECL) and surface-enhanced Raman scattering (SERS) for dual-mode readouts. The biosensor uses a Ti3C2/CsPbBr3@PDA@AuNPs nanocomposite (PAM) as a transducing interface, where hemin functions as both an ECL-modulating species and a SERS reporter. The biosensor's design allows for programmable DNA switching via CRISPR-Cas12a, enabling ratiometric quantification of RABV RNA over a wide range of concentrations (1 aM to 50 fM). The study highlights the potential of this biosensor for sensitive and accurate rabies viral RNA analysis, which could improve surveillance and diagnostic capabilities. However, the study notes that control experiments only link hemin-associated ECL modulation to interfacial configuration without confirming a unique quenching pathway, which may limit the interpretation of the findings. The biosensor's performance was tested in phosphate-buffered saline and human serum, showing partial matrix-effect compensation. The results suggest that this biosensor could be a valuable tool for detecting rabies virus in clinical and field settings, but further validation is needed to confirm its reliability and specificity.

abstract_zh: 低丰度 狂犬病 病毒 RNA (RABV RNA) 的可靠检测需要灵敏的读数,能够耐受界面和基质相关的信号变化。我们开发了一种结合电化学发光 (ECL) 和表面增强拉曼散射 (SERS) 的 DNA 四面体限制 G4 纳米镊子生物传感器。Ti 3 C 2 /CsPbBr 3 @PDA@AuNPs 纳米复合材料 (PAM) 提供双模式转导界面,氯高铁血红素既充当 ECL 调节物质,又充当 SERS 报道分子。CsPbBr 3 充当ECL发射器,PDA改善界面稳定性,AuNP提供SERS热点和DNA锚定位点,Ti 3 C 2 充当导电支架。如果没有目标 RNA,桥接链 (ST) 会促进闭合的 G4/氯化血红素构型,产生高 SERS 和低 ECL 信号。RABV RNA 触发的结合诱导的等温扩增产生了 CRISPR-Cas12a 的单链 DNA 激活剂。随后的 ST 裂解阻止了纳米镊子的闭合并减少了界面血红素的富集,从而产生了 ECL-on/SERS-off 响应。对照实验将氯化血红素相关的 ECL 调节与界面结构联系起来,但没有建立独特的微观猝灭途径。比率信号 R = I ECL /I SERS 可实现 1 aM 至 50 fM 范围内的定量。额外的低浓度校准通过空白阈值逆预测产生了 0.0675 aM 的估计检测限,推断低于 0.10 aM 的最低测量非零标准。在 10 fM 时,匹配通道比较得出十个连续读数的比率相对标准偏差为 2.49%,六个独立制备的电极的比率相对标准偏差为 2.87%。在 10 fM 十倍稀释的人血清中,该比率显示与磷酸盐缓冲盐水有 8.20% 的绝对偏差,表明部分基质效应补偿。这种共享报告架构将可编程 DNA 切换与互补光学读数连接起来,以进行灵敏的比率病毒 RNA 分析。

title: Digital reminder systems for improving adherence to anti-rabies vaccination among animal bite victims: A systematic review
abstract: Background and objectives Digital reminder systems may improve adherence to scheduled vaccination visits. This systematic review aimed to evaluate the effectiveness of digital reminder interventions in improving adherence to and completion of anti-rabies vaccination among animal bite patients. Methods A systematic search of PubMed, EMBASE, Web of Science, and the Cochrane Library was conducted on September 28, 2025 following a registered PROSPERO protocol (CRD420251148817). Two reviewers independently screened studies using NESTED Knowledge, extracted data, and assessed study quality using the Cochrane RoB-2 tool and the JBI critical appraisal checklist. Results Of 733 records identified, 436 remained after duplicate record removal and were screened by the title and abstract. Twelve studies underwent full-text assessment, and three that met the inclusion criteria were conducted in Tanzania, Kenya, and India. Two quasi-experimental studies evaluated SMS reminder systems, and one randomised controlled trial evaluated telephonic reminders. All studies reported improved adherence to scheduled anti-rabies vaccination compared with routine care. Vaccination completion was 70% vs 53% in the telephonic reminder trial and 93% vs 78% in the SMS reminder study. In the Tanzanian study adherence improved across four doses (62%, 50%, 29%, 13%) with SMS reminders compared with controls (48%, 41%, 22%, 7%). Differences in study design, vaccination regimens, and intervention modalities limited direct comparison across studies. Interpretation and conclusions Digital reminder interventions may improve adherence to anti-rabies vaccination schedules, but available evidence is limited and heterogeneous, resulting in low certainty of evidence. Larger randomised trials are required to determine the effectiveness and scalability of digital reminder systems.

analysis.summary_en: This systematic review evaluates the effectiveness of digital reminder systems in improving adherence to anti-rabies vaccination among animal bite victims. The study aimed to assess whether such interventions could enhance vaccination completion rates. A systematic search of multiple databases was conducted, and three studies from Tanzania, Kenya, and India were included. The results showed that all studies reported improved adherence compared to routine care. However, the evidence is limited and heterogeneous, with differences in study design and intervention modalities preventing direct comparisons. The findings suggest that digital reminders may be beneficial for improving vaccination adherence, which is crucial for rabies prevention. Despite the promising results, the low certainty of evidence highlights the need for larger randomised trials to determine the effectiveness and scalability of these systems.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 数字提醒系统可以提高对预定 疫苗接种 就诊的遵守率。本系统评价旨在评估数字提醒干预措施在提高动物咬伤患者遵守和完成抗 狂犬病 疫苗接种 治疗方面的有效性。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 2025 年 9 月 28 日,按照注册的 PROSPERO 协议 (CRD420251148817) 对 PubMed、EMBASE、Web of Science 和 Cochrane 图书馆进行了系统检索。十二项研究进行了全文评估,其中三项符合纳入标准,是在坦桑尼亚、肯尼亚和印度进行的。
elements_zh.methods: 两名评审员使用 NESTED Knowledge 独立筛选研究,提取数据,并使用 Cochrane RoB-2 工具和 JBI 批判性评估清单评估研究质量。

title_zh: 用于提高动物咬伤受害者对 狂犬病 疫苗接种 的依从性的数字提醒系统:系统评价
source_body_en: Background and objectives Digital reminder systems may improve adherence to scheduled vaccination visits. This systematic review aimed to evaluate the effectiveness of digital reminder interventions in improving adherence to and completion of anti-rabies vaccination among animal bite patients. Methods A systematic search of PubMed, EMBASE, Web of Science, and the Cochrane Library was conducted on September 28, 2025 following a registered PROSPERO protocol (CRD420251148817). Two reviewers independently screened studies using NESTED Knowledge, extracted data, and assessed study quality using the Cochrane RoB-2 tool and the JBI critical appraisal checklist. Results Of 733 records identified, 436 remained after duplicate record removal and were screened by the title and abstract. Twelve studies underwent full-text assessment, and three that met the inclusion criteria were conducted in Tanzania, Kenya, and India. Two quasi-experimental studies evaluated SMS reminder systems, and one randomised controlled trial evaluated telephonic reminders. All studies reported improved adherence to scheduled anti-rabies vaccination compared with routine care. Vaccination completion was 70% vs 53% in the telephonic reminder trial and 93% vs 78% in the SMS reminder study. In the Tanzanian study adherence improved across four doses (62%, 50%, 29%, 13%) with SMS reminders compared with controls (48%, 41%, 22%, 7%). Differences in study design, vaccination regimens, and intervention modalities limited direct comparison across studies. Interpretation and conclusions Digital reminder interventions may improve adherence to anti-rabies vaccination schedules, but available evidence is limited and heterogeneous, resulting in low certainty of evidence. Larger randomised trials are required to determine the effectiveness and scalability of digital reminder systems.
abstract_zh: 背景和目标 数字提醒系统可以提高对预定 疫苗接种 就诊的遵守率。本系统评价旨在评估数字提醒干预措施在提高动物咬伤患者遵守和完成抗 狂犬病 疫苗接种 治疗方面的有效性。方法 按照注册的 PROSPERO 方案 (CRD420251148817),于 2025 年 9 月 28 日对 PubMed、EMBASE、Web of Science 和 Cochrane 图书馆进行了系统检索。两名评审员使用 NESTED Knowledge 独立筛选研究,提取数据,并使用 Cochrane RoB-2 工具和 JBI 批判性评估清单评估研究质量。结果 在识别出的 733 条记录中,删除重复记录后保留 436 条,并通过标题和摘要进行筛选。十二项研究进行了全文评估,其中三项符合纳入标准,是在坦桑尼亚、肯尼亚和印度进行的。两项准实验研究评估了短信提醒系统,一项随机对照试验评估了电话提醒。所有研究均报告与常规护理相比,对预定抗 狂犬病 疫苗接种 的依从性有所提高。在电话提醒试验中,疫苗接种 的完成率为 70% 对 53%,在短信提醒研究中完成率为 93% 对 78%。在坦桑尼亚的研究中,与对照组(48%、41%、22%、7%)相比,使用短信提醒的四种剂量(62%、50%、29%、13%)的依从性有所提高。研究设计、疫苗接种 方案和干预方式的差异限制了研究之间的直接比较。解释和结论数字提醒干预措施可能会提高对反 狂犬病 疫苗接种 时间表的依从性,但可用证据有限且异构,导致证据质量低。需要更大规模的随机试验来确定数字提醒系统的有效性和可扩展性。

title: Rabies risk and response in tea-estate health systems in Assam, India: a constructivist grounded theory analysis.
abstract: INTRODUCTION: Dog-mediated rabies disproportionately affects marginalised and geographically isolated communities, including tea-estate (TE) populations in Assam, India. Although epidemiological patterns of rabies transmission are well documented, the structural, behavioural and governance mechanisms shaping prevention and response within estate-based health systems remain poorly understood. This study used a constructivist grounded theory approach to examine how TE health systems perceive and respond to rabies risk. METHODS: We conducted 26 interview events comprising 25 in-depth individual interviews and one group interview, involving 28 participants from estate healthcare, welfare, management and labour representative roles across 10 TE in Udalguri district, Assam. Purposive maximum-variation sampling ensured representation across roles, responsibilities and decision-making influence. Initial line-by-line coding, constant comparison, focused category development and memo writing informed the development of an emergent explanatory model, which subsequently informed an applied theory of change. Rigour was ensured through reflexive team discussions, consensus-based resolution of coding discrepancies and adherence to Consolidated Criteria for Reporting Qualitative Research (COREQ) criteria. RESULTS: Responses to rabies risk were shaped by five interacting mechanisms: structural inequities in access to postexposure prophylaxis; incident-driven vigilance; fragmented governance and the absence of institutionalised dog-population management; limited health literacy resulting from ineffective communication approaches and weak surveillance systems. Collectively, these processes produced a system that remains predominantly reactive rather than preventive, perpetuating cycles of delayed care, incomplete prophylaxis and unmanaged dog-human interfaces. The emergent theory of change highlights feasible opportunities for shifting estate-based systems towards proactive rabies prevention. CONCLUSION: This study offers an analytically transferable health-systems model that may inform structurally peripheral or semi-autonomous labour communities across comparable plantation, industrial and labour settlements in South and Southeast Asia, identifying implementation pathways aligned with India's National Action Plan for Rabies Elimination 2030 and the global 'Zero by 30' agenda.

title_zh: 印度阿萨姆邦茶园卫生系统的 狂犬病 风险与应对:建构主义扎根理论分析。
source_body_en: INTRODUCTION: Dog-mediated rabies disproportionately affects marginalised and geographically isolated communities, including tea-estate (TE) populations in Assam, India. Although epidemiological patterns of rabies transmission are well documented, the structural, behavioural and governance mechanisms shaping prevention and response within estate-based health systems remain poorly understood. This study used a constructivist grounded theory approach to examine how TE health systems perceive and respond to rabies risk. METHODS: We conducted 26 interview events comprising 25 in-depth individual interviews and one group interview, involving 28 participants from estate healthcare, welfare, management and labour representative roles across 10 TE in Udalguri district, Assam. Purposive maximum-variation sampling ensured representation across roles, responsibilities and decision-making influence. Initial line-by-line coding, constant comparison, focused category development and memo writing informed the development of an emergent explanatory model, which subsequently informed an applied theory of change. Rigour was ensured through reflexive team discussions, consensus-based resolution of coding discrepancies and adherence to Consolidated Criteria for Reporting Qualitative Research (COREQ) criteria. RESULTS: Responses to rabies risk were shaped by five interacting mechanisms: structural inequities in access to postexposure prophylaxis; incident-driven vigilance; fragmented governance and the absence of institutionalised dog-population management; limited health literacy resulting from ineffective communication approaches and weak surveillance systems. Collectively, these processes produced a system that remains predominantly reactive rather than preventive, perpetuating cycles of delayed care, incomplete prophylaxis and unmanaged dog-human interfaces. The emergent theory of change highlights feasible opportunities for shifting estate-based systems towards proactive rabies prevention. CONCLUSION: This study offers an analytically transferable health-systems model that may inform structurally peripheral or semi-autonomous labour communities across comparable plantation, industrial and labour settlements in South and Southeast Asia, identifying implementation pathways aligned with India's National Action Plan for Rabies Elimination 2030 and the global 'Zero by 30' agenda.
abstract_zh: 简介:狗介导的 狂犬病 对边缘化和地理上孤立的社区造成了不成比例的影响,包括印度阿萨姆邦的茶园 (TE) 人口。尽管 狂犬病 传播 的流行病学模式已有详细记录,但对基于庄园的卫生系统内形成预防和应对的结构、行为和治理机制仍知之甚少。本研究使用建构主义扎根理论方法来研究 TE 卫生系统如何感知和应对 狂犬病 风险。方法:我们进行了 26 场访谈活动,其中包括 25 场深度个人访谈和 1 场集体访谈,涉及阿萨姆邦 Udalguri 地区 10 个 TE 的房地产医疗保健、福利、管理和劳工代表职位的 28 名参与者。有目的的最大变异抽样确保了角色、职责和决策影响力的代表性。最初的逐行编码、不断比较、重点类别开发和备忘录编写为新兴解释模型的发展提供了信息,该模型随后为应用变革理论提供了信息。通过反思性的团队讨论、基于共识的编码差异解决方案以及遵守定性研究报告综合标准 (COREQ),确保了严谨性。结果:对 狂犬病 风险的反应由五种相互作用的机制决定:获得暴露后预防的结构性不平等;事件驱动的警惕;治理分散,缺乏制度化的犬只管理;由于沟通方法无效和 监测 系统薄弱,健康素养有限。总的来说,这些过程产生了一个主要是反应性而非预防性的系统,延迟护理、不完全预防和不受管理的狗与人界面的持续循环。新兴的变革理论强调了将基于财产的系统转向主动 狂犬病 预防的可行机会。结论:本研究提供了一种分析上可转移的卫生系统模型,可以为南亚和东南亚类似种植园、工业和劳工住区的结构性外围或半自治劳工社区提供信息,确定与印度《2030 年消除 狂犬病 国家行动计划》和全球“零到 30”议程相一致的实施路径。

title: Effectiveness Of a Structured Teaching Programme on Knowledge Regarding First Aid Management of Dog Bite Among Mothers: A Pre-Experimental Study
abstract: Background: Dog bites constitute a significant public health problem, particularly among children, and are associated with physical trauma, wound infections, and the risk of fatal rabies transmission. Mothers, as primary caregivers, are pivotal in delivering immediate first aid; however, their knowledge regarding appropriate first aid management of dog bites is often inadequate. Structured teaching programmes (STPs) have demonstrated effectiveness in improving health-related knowledge in community settings. Objectives: To assess pre-test knowledge of mothers regarding first aid management of dog bite; to evaluate the effectiveness of an STP by comparing pre- and post-test scores; and to determine the association between pre-test knowledge and selected demographic variables. Methods: A pre-experimental one-group pre-test post-test design was employed. Fifty (N=50) mothers of children below 9 years residing in Aliparamba Panchayat Ward-4, Malappuram district, Kerala, were selected by non-probability convenience sampling. Data were collected using a self-developed structured knowledge questionnaire, whose content validity and reliability were established before data collection. A 30-minute STP incorporating pamphlets and demonstrations was delivered. Reliability and content validity were established through expert review and a pilot study. Descriptive statistics, paired t-test, and chi-square test were used for analysis. Results: Pre-test assessment revealed that 12% of mothers had poor knowledge, 78% had average knowledge, and 10% had good knowledge (mean 8.84, SD 2.38). Post-test findings showed a marked improvement: 76% of mothers achieved good knowledge and 24% average knowledge, with none remaining in the poor category (mean 15.72, SD 1.08). The mean difference was 6.88. The paired t-test yielded t(49)=19.47 (p 0.05). Conclusion: The STP significantly improved mothers' knowledge regarding first aid management of dog bites. Community-based educational interventions are recommended to empower caregivers, reduce complications, and mitigate rabies-related morbidity and mortality.

title_zh: 母亲被狗咬伤急救管理知识结构化教学计划的有效性:一项预实验研究
source_body_en: Background: Dog bites constitute a significant public health problem, particularly among children, and are associated with physical trauma, wound infections, and the risk of fatal rabies transmission. Mothers, as primary caregivers, are pivotal in delivering immediate first aid; however, their knowledge regarding appropriate first aid management of dog bites is often inadequate. Structured teaching programmes (STPs) have demonstrated effectiveness in improving health-related knowledge in community settings. Objectives: To assess pre-test knowledge of mothers regarding first aid management of dog bite; to evaluate the effectiveness of an STP by comparing pre- and post-test scores; and to determine the association between pre-test knowledge and selected demographic variables. Methods: A pre-experimental one-group pre-test post-test design was employed. Fifty (N=50) mothers of children below 9 years residing in Aliparamba Panchayat Ward-4, Malappuram district, Kerala, were selected by non-probability convenience sampling. Data were collected using a self-developed structured knowledge questionnaire, whose content validity and reliability were established before data collection. A 30-minute STP incorporating pamphlets and demonstrations was delivered. Reliability and content validity were established through expert review and a pilot study. Descriptive statistics, paired t-test, and chi-square test were used for analysis. Results: Pre-test assessment revealed that 12% of mothers had poor knowledge, 78% had average knowledge, and 10% had good knowledge (mean 8.84, SD 2.38). Post-test findings showed a marked improvement: 76% of mothers achieved good knowledge and 24% average knowledge, with none remaining in the poor category (mean 15.72, SD 1.08). The mean difference was 6.88. The paired t-test yielded t(49)=19.47 (p 0.05). Conclusion: The STP significantly improved mothers' knowledge regarding first aid management of dog bites. Community-based educational interventions are recommended to empower caregivers, reduce complications, and mitigate rabies-related morbidity and mortality.
abstract_zh: 背景:狗咬伤构成了一个重大的公共卫生问题,特别是在儿童中,并与身体创伤、伤口感染和致命的 狂犬病 传播 风险相关。母亲作为主要照顾者,在提供即时急救方面发挥着关键作用;然而,他们对狗咬伤的适当急救处理的了解往往不足。结构化教学计划 (STP) 已证明可以有效提高社区环境中的健康相关知识。目的:评估母亲在被狗咬伤后的急救处理方面的考前知识;通过比较测试前和测试后的分数来评估 STP 的有效性;并确定预测试知识与选定的人口统计变量之间的关联。方法:采用实验前一组前测后测设计。通过非概率便利抽样,选择了居住在喀拉拉邦 Malappuram 区 Aliparamba Panchayat Ward-4 的 50 名 (N=50) 9 岁以下儿童母亲。使用自行开发的结构化知识调查问卷收集数据,在数据收集之前确定其内容的有效性和可靠性。提供了包含小册子和演示的 30 分钟 STP。通过专家评审和试点研究确定了可靠性和内容有效性。采用描述性统计、配对t检验和卡方检验进行分析。结果:预测试评估显示,12%的母亲知识较差,78%的母亲知识一般,10%的母亲知识良好(平均8.84,标准差2.38)。测试后的结果显示出明显的进步:76% 的母亲获得了良好的知识,24% 的母亲达到了平均知识,没有人处于贫困类别(平均值 15.72,标准差 1.08)。平均差异为 6.88。配对 t 检验得出 t(49)=19.47 (p < 0.05)。结论:STP 显着提高了母亲对狗咬伤急救处理的了解。建议采取基于社区的教育干预措施,以增强护理人员的能力,减少并发症,并减轻 狂犬病 相关发病率和 死亡率。

title: Frontline recognition and referral readiness for selected priority zoonoses among health workers in southwestern Uganda: a One Health systems assessment
abstract: Abstract Background: Southwestern Uganda is a livestock-intensive region vulnerable to recurrent zoonotic disease outbreaks. Because confirmation of several priority zoonoses depends on higher-level or reference laboratories, preparedness requires both frontline recognition and effective specimen referral. We assessed recognition and referral readiness and related One Health implementation gaps among health workers in southwestern Uganda. Methods We conducted a cross-sectional survey among 345 health workers in Mbarara, Kazo, Kiruhura, and Ibanda districts. The study focused on Rift Valley fever (RVF), Crimean-Congo haemorrhagic fever (CCHF), Ebola, anthrax, and rabies. Participants were purposively recruited across facility levels based on frontline roles in recognition, specimen handling, referral, or reporting of suspected zoonoses. Recognition readiness was assessed using 11 disease-specific causative-agent and transmission/exposure items. Referral readiness was assessed using testing advice, specimen referral, result feedback, referral-to-result interval, and result communication. The primary outcome was a reported referral-linkage gap, defined as not reporting specimen referral elsewhere for testing. Modified Poisson regression with facility-clustered robust standard errors was used to estimate prevalence ratios. Results Almost all respondents had heard of the selected zoonoses (99.7%). Recognition was lower for RVF exposure through aborted fetuses or placentas (58.8%) and mosquito transmission (69.9%). Overall, 13.9% reported a referral-linkage gap, which was more common at lower-level facilities than at health centre IVs or hospitals (20.1% vs 6.8%; adjusted prevalence ratio [aPR]=2.74; 95% confidence interval [CI]=1.39–5.39; p =0.004). Among respondents reporting referral, 99.3% reported receiving results; the median referral-to-result interval was 10 days (IQR, 7–14). Commonly reported barriers were inadequate diagnostic resources (90.4%), unreliable transport (75.1%), and inadequate intersectoral collaboration (74.2%). Conclusions Frontline recognition of selected priority zoonoses was generally strong, but referral readiness was less consistent at lower levels of care. Strengthening peripheral specimen-referral connectivity, transport, information exchange, and One Health coordination should complement continued targeted disease-specific training.

title_zh: 乌干达西南部卫生工作者对选定的优先人畜共患病的一线认识和转诊准备情况:单一卫生系统评估
source_body_en: Abstract Background: Southwestern Uganda is a livestock-intensive region vulnerable to recurrent zoonotic disease outbreaks. Because confirmation of several priority zoonoses depends on higher-level or reference laboratories, preparedness requires both frontline recognition and effective specimen referral. We assessed recognition and referral readiness and related One Health implementation gaps among health workers in southwestern Uganda. Methods We conducted a cross-sectional survey among 345 health workers in Mbarara, Kazo, Kiruhura, and Ibanda districts. The study focused on Rift Valley fever (RVF), Crimean-Congo haemorrhagic fever (CCHF), Ebola, anthrax, and rabies. Participants were purposively recruited across facility levels based on frontline roles in recognition, specimen handling, referral, or reporting of suspected zoonoses. Recognition readiness was assessed using 11 disease-specific causative-agent and transmission/exposure items. Referral readiness was assessed using testing advice, specimen referral, result feedback, referral-to-result interval, and result communication. The primary outcome was a reported referral-linkage gap, defined as not reporting specimen referral elsewhere for testing. Modified Poisson regression with facility-clustered robust standard errors was used to estimate prevalence ratios. Results Almost all respondents had heard of the selected zoonoses (99.7%). Recognition was lower for RVF exposure through aborted fetuses or placentas (58.8%) and mosquito transmission (69.9%). Overall, 13.9% reported a referral-linkage gap, which was more common at lower-level facilities than at health centre IVs or hospitals (20.1% vs 6.8%; adjusted prevalence ratio [aPR]=2.74; 95% confidence interval [CI]=1.39–5.39; p =0.004). Among respondents reporting referral, 99.3% reported receiving results; the median referral-to-result interval was 10 days (IQR, 7–14). Commonly reported barriers were inadequate diagnostic resources (90.4%), unreliable transport (75.1%), and inadequate intersectoral collaboration (74.2%). Conclusions Frontline recognition of selected priority zoonoses was generally strong, but referral readiness was less consistent at lower levels of care. Strengthening peripheral specimen-referral connectivity, transport, information exchange, and One Health coordination should complement continued targeted disease-specific training.

title: Age-related patterns in delayed presentation and pre-hospital wound management for rabies post-exposure prophylaxis: a retrospective hospital-based study in Hangzhou, China, 2022–2025
abstract: Abstract Background Timely rabies post-exposure prophylaxis (PEP) and appropriate wound care are essential after potential rabies exposure, and older adults may face barriers to both. This study described presentation timing and pre-hospital wound management in a hospital-based cohort in Hangzhou, China. Methods This retrospective cross-sectional study included 3327 exposure-related clinic presentations between October 2022 and October 2025 after exclusion of 7 system-test entries, 15 WHO Category I exposures, 13 confirmed continuation visits, 10 contradictory-date records and 2 unresolved duplicate records. Subsequent-calendar-day presentation was a date-based operational proxy for delay. Separate multivariable logistic models evaluated presentation timing and any pre-hospital wound self-treatment. Results 218/3327 (6.6%) exposure-related presentations occurred on a subsequent calendar day. The clinic-opening calendar period (October–December 2022) was associated with subsequent-calendar-day presentation (AOR 2.54, 95% CI 1.63–3.96; P < 0.001), as was pre-hospital wound self-treatment (AOR 2.72, 95% CI 2.00–3.69; P < 0.001). Patients aged ≥ 65 years had higher adjusted odds of subsequent-calendar-day presentation than those aged 15–44 years (AOR 2.28, 95% CI 1.31–3.96; P = 0.003). The estimate for any self-treatment in the ≥ 65-year group was lower but did not reach the conventional significance threshold (AOR 0.71, 95% CI 0.50–1.01; P = 0.056). Conclusions In this hospital-based cohort, older age was associated with subsequent-calendar-day presentation. The estimate for lower self-treatment among older adults was imprecise and requires confirmation; the two outcomes were modelled separately and do not establish a combined individual-level outcome. Associations with the clinic-opening calendar period should be interpreted as exploratory because they may reflect clinic establishment, case mix, seasonality, or unmeasured access factors. Trial registration Clinical trial number: Not applicable.
